name: Clock probe: the global cooldown reads its remaining game time in the middle of the GCD
contract: Slow Fall 130 in the installed Spell.dbc is instant, self-castable and reagent-free, with StartRecoveryCategory
133 and StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms. Spell::TriggerGlobalCooldown keeps 1500 inside [MIN_GCD, MAX_GCD] and
scales it by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED, which is 1.0 for the fresh level-80 mage (asserted), so the cast starts a
1500 ms category-133 global cooldown. GlobalCooldownMgr stores its start in game milliseconds and
GetGlobalCooldown subtracts getMSTime(). The Slow Fall aura shows that the cast was accepted before any
reading. Three step ticks after the cast 1300..1500 ms remain. After a 700 ms wait the reading has fallen by at
least 700 ms and by at most 1050 ms, leaving 400..800 ms, and it reaches 0 within the following 1.5 s. The
bands cover the step ticks around the wait for world ticks up to about 50 ms. A getMSTime() that is not the
simulated game time leaves the reading near 1500 after a fast-forwarded wait; one that runs half again as fast
as game time makes it fall by more than 1050 ms.

steps.label: SETUP: no category-133 global cooldown is running
SETUP: no haste scales the global cooldown
SETUP: the cast applied Slow Fall
Global cooldown right after the cast
SETUP: the cast started the 1500 ms global cooldown
Wait into the middle of the global cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: the global cooldown fell by the game time that passed
The global cooldown ends on time
